declarations.name: AuiHeading
declarations.description: `<h2 auiHeading size="4">`: the level comes from the tag, `size` (1 largest to 6) sets the visual size.
declarations.selector: h1[auiHeading], h2[auiHeading], h3[auiHeading], h4[auiHeading], h5[auiHeading], h6[auiHeading]

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Heading: visual size, default the level. Text: font size, default md.

accessibility.pattern:
Native HTML text semantics:

-

,

, , . Visual size is decoupled from heading level.

limitations: The external-link hint is resolved at creation time; later locale changes do not update existing links.
aui-line-clamp relies on -webkit-line-clamp (supported by all current engines); the standard line-clamp property is declared for forward compatibility.
aui-prose styles only p, ul, ol, li, h2 to h4, a, code, pre, and blockquote.
No external-link icon; the hint is text for assistive technology only.
